questions.description: 用集合求两字符串公共字符。
questions.code_template:
a = "hello"
b = "world"
common = set(a) & set(b)
print('Common:',___)
questions.solution:
a = "hello"
b = "world"
common = set(a) & set(b)
print('Common:', sorted(common))

questions.code_template:
text = "the cat the dog"
words = text.split()
unique = set(words)
print(___, sorted(unique))
questions.solution:
text = "the cat the dog"
words = text.split()
unique = set(words)
print(len(unique), sorted(unique))

questions.code_template:
s = {4, 9, 2, 7}
print(___, min(s), len(s))
questions.solution:
s = {4, 9, 2, 7}

questions.description: 集合应用：去除重复后平均。
questions.code_template:
nums = [1, 1, 2, 3, 3]
unique = set(nums)
print(___)
questions.solution:
nums = [1, 1, 2, 3, 3]
unique = set(nums)
print(f"Average: {sum(unique) / len(unique)}")

questions.code_template:
words = ["hello", "help"]
common = set(words[0])
for w in words[1:]:
    common &= set(w)
print('Common:',___)
questions.solution:
words = ["hello", "help"]
common = set(words[0])
for w in words[1:]:
    common &= set(w)
print('Common:', sorted(common))
